probe_detail.name: Premise is specific rather than generic
Setup commits to one misleading reading

final.name: External-source trace
final.audit_justification: Measures presence of sourcing/attribution language, a textual fingerprint of the item's origin rather than the joke's own comic content, but sourced material could genuinely be funnier if drawn from tested source jokes.

final.name: Reads as freshly minted rather than a circulated chestnut
final.audit_justification: Scores staleness/novelty of the material as a production-history marker, explicitly excluding how the item is received, though genuinely original construction may also indicate more authorial effort and quality.
final.arbiter_reason: Recognisability of the material is a fact about the joke's circulation history rather than about its comic construction, and the instruction explicitly bars the judge from considering reception, so a high score certifies that the text is unfamiliar, not that it is funny. Freshly assembled premises do plausibly track real authorial effort, so it is reported both ways.

final.name: Nerdy or Academic Wordplay
final.audit_justification: Flags reliance on STEM/academic subject-matter knowledge, a topic marker, though constructing wordplay that needs specialist knowledge can also require real cleverness.
final.arbiter_reason: The instruction scores whether the punchline requires STEM/academic subject knowledge, which is a topic marker: a flat joke about protons scores 10 and a brilliant non-technical pun scores 0, so the scale never grades cleverness. The upstream cause is subject-matter selection and audience niche, which carries no reliable tie to genuine comic quality.

final.name: Presupposed familiarity: variant, remix or knowing-repost framing
final.audit_justification: Scores self-presentation as a repost/remix/variant, a production-history and venue-familiarity marker explicitly excluding whether the reuse is skillful, though a clever remix can also be genuinely funnier.
final.upstream_parent: the item's position in the retelling chain of a joke that has circulated before

final.name: Datable topical reference fixing the item to one forum era
final.audit_justification: Scores how tightly the text is pinned to a datable reference, a pure temporal tell explicitly excluding staleness/quality judgment.
final.upstream_parent: submission timing / era of the forum's conventions and taste -- where the item sits in the forum's history

final.name: Compression and economy
final.audit_justification: Framed around economy/verbosity, matching the incidental length category directly, though disciplined editing can also indicate an author who genuinely writes tighter, better jokes.
final.arbiter_reason: The criterion is not word count but whether each word earns its place in the comic effect, which is timing and editing craft and is constitutive of whether a joke lands rather than merely travelling with it. A judge scoring padding versus economy against the comic payoff is measuring the construct, so it joins the bank despite its surface resemblance to length.

final.name: Retroactive Reinterpretation
final.audit_justification: Retroactive reinterpretation of the setup by the punchline is a core comic mechanism and thus direct evidence of the joke's construction quality.

final.name: Orthographic error as accident versus orthography as deliberate device
final.audit_justification: Scores care/carelessness in spelling as a signal of whether the item was proofread, an orthographic-habit/production marker, though a careful poster may also be a generally better writer.
final.arbiter_reason: Although the criterion usefully separates a load-bearing respelling from an accidental typo, its zero anchor is explicitly 'posted without a reread', making the scale a proofreading-care marker about the circumstances of production. Posters who reread plausibly also write better jokes, so it is reported in both the discounted and undiscounted readouts.

final.name: Platform in-group meta-humor about the joke's own reception
final.audit_justification: Requires judging whether the forum-mechanics content is actually turned into a genuine ironic punchline rather than a flat complaint, which is a judgment about comic execution, not mere topic presence.

final.name: Audience-Management Meta-Framing
final.audit_justification: Scores mere presence of apologetic/anticipatory meta-framing about forum reception, a venue-style marker explicitly excluding whether it's warranted, and if anything correlates with weaker not stronger jokes.

final.name: Verbosity and layout load
final.audit_justification: Scores prose/formatting bulk explicitly excluding any effect on timing or humor, a pure length/layout marker.

final.name: Textual completeness and legibility
final.audit_justification: Legibility/completeness is a textual-fingerprint/formatting property, but a garbled or truncated item may fail to land for the same reason a careful one succeeds, so the underlying care plausibly also yields real quality.
final.arbiter_reason: Truncation, broken formatting and missing context are textual fingerprints of how the item was posted rather than properties of its humor, and the criterion's zero anchor is entirely such surface obstruction. Comprehensibility is a precondition for a joke landing, so the underlying care plausibly produces genuine quality too.

final.name: Transgression carried by a mechanism, not by shock alone
final.audit_justification: Directly judges whether a genuine comic mechanism (versus shock alone) is doing the work, which is a substantive claim about comic construction.

final.name: Cleanliness of commitment to one delivery format
final.audit_justification: Scores structural conformity to a delivery template only, explicitly excluding whether the punch is good, a pure format marker, though format discipline may track a more practised, genuinely better writer.
final.upstream_parent: poster's accumulated practice in writing for this format (how many times they have done this before)

final.name: Orthographic noise
final.audit_justification: Counts orthographic errors/inconsistencies explicitly excluding whether they are effective, a production-care marker that may also track a generally weaker or stronger writer.

final.name: Forum/Platform Meta-Reference
final.audit_justification: Scores mere presence of platform/voting-mechanism references explicitly excluding whether it makes the text good or bad, a pure venue marker.
final.upstream_parent: author's practice in the format / audience engagement strategy

final.name: Vivid concrete imagery
final.audit_justification: Vivid concrete imagery is a substantive property of the writing that helps the content actually land, not a stylistic fingerprint.

final.name: Explicit external attribution or citation line
final.audit_justification: Scores presence/prominence of an attribution line explicitly excluding quality of the cited material or of crediting, a sourcing/production marker, though sourced material could be genuinely funnier.
final.upstream_parent: sourcing versus origination -- whether the item was transcribed/lifted from elsewhere rather than written for this post

final.name: Transformed cultural allusion
final.audit_justification: Judges whether an allusion is actively repurposed into new comic material versus merely referenced, a substantive transformation/craft distinction.

final.name: Clean semantic double-use
final.audit_justification: Judges whether a clean double meaning genuinely supports both setup and punchline, a core pun-mechanism craft judgment.

final.name: Punchline closure / resolution
final.audit_justification: Judges whether the joke actually resolves with a self-contained payoff versus trailing off, a structural completeness judgment central to whether the joke works as a joke.

final.name: Topical/political specificity
final.audit_justification: Scores dependence on a named contemporary political figure/event, a subject-matter and temporal-currency marker unrelated to craft.
final.arbiter_reason: Dependence on a named contemporary political figure or news event is simultaneously a topic marker and a temporal tell, and the scale grades subject matter with no reference to craft or comic mechanism. Nothing about choosing a political referent plausibly produces genuine funniness, so no undiscounted readout is warranted.

final.name: Reliance on Shock or Taboo Subjects
final.audit_justification: Scores reliance on taboo/dark/sexual subject matter as such, a subject-matter marker, though willingness and ability to handle taboo material well may also track genuine comic skill.

final.name: Read-aloud cadence
final.audit_justification: Judges whether phrasing creates a natural spoken rhythm/landing, a timing/delivery property that is part of the joke's own comic effect rather than a surface marker.

final.name: Natural phonetic transformation
final.audit_justification: Judges whether a sound-alike transformation smoothly produces the punchline, a core wordplay-mechanism craft judgment.
